security_audit.summary: The audit confirmed remote pipe-to-shell execution, unsafe filename insertion into HTML, transcript exposure of guest keys, and authenticated requests to caller-selected origins. Most scanner matches are false positives from documentation, JavaScript template literals, loopback tests, and expected CLI file or network operations. No prompt injection or obfuscated payload evidence was found. Static review was capped at 400/531 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 131 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: The SkillHub workflow executes an unpinned remote installer through Bash.
remediation.suggestion: Download a versioned artifact, verify a pinned checksum or signature, and execute only after verification.

remediation.issue: Authenticated API requests can use a caller-controlled origin.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS, allowlist trusted ShareOne origins, and attach credentials only after exact origin validation.

remediation.issue: A filename is inserted into innerHTML without escaping.
remediation.suggestion: Create elements with textContent and set the filename as text instead of HTML.

remediation.issue: Guest API keys are printed and relayed through agent transcripts.
remediation.suggestion: Return a one-time retrieval link or store the key directly without printing the bearer value.

remediation.issue: Generated pages load a floating Mermaid version from a third-party CDN.
remediation.suggestion: Self-host a pinned Mermaid build or verify an exact immutable asset before publication.

content.value_statement: Sharing pages and documents securely can require several tools and manual steps. This skill publishes content and manages ShareOne links from one workflow.
actual_capabilities: Publishes local HTML, Markdown, and text files as ShareOne pages.
Uploads PDF, Word, and PowerPoint documents through the binary file workflow.
Sets passwords, watermarks, custom slugs, comments, and page data options.
Downloads shared content and refreshes pages linked to supported remote sources.
Lists, replies to, resolves, and dismisses review comments.
Adds, removes, and lists collaborators for owned shares.
limitations: Owner actions require a ShareOne API key and network access.
Published content is sent to an external ShareOne service.
Binary document content cannot be updated in place through the provided publishing script.
Remote publishing depends on the service allowlist and source availability.

use_cases.title: Share a project page
use_cases.description: Publish an HTML or Markdown project update with a stable link and optional access controls.

use_cases.title: Distribute protected documents
use_cases.description: Upload a report or presentation with a password, watermark, or custom link name.

use_cases.title: Process review feedback
use_cases.description: Read page comments, update the existing share, reply, and close completed feedback threads.

prompt_templates.title: Publish a page
prompt_templates.prompt: Publish [file path] to ShareOne and return the generated link.
prompt_templates.scenario: First publication of a local page

prompt_templates.title: Protect a document
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload [document path] to ShareOne with password [password] and watermark [watermark].

prompt_templates.title: Update link settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Update [ShareOne link] to use slug [slug], enable comments, and preserve its content.
prompt_templates.scenario: Metadata changes on an existing share

prompt_templates.title: Complete a review cycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Review unresolved comments on [ShareOne link], apply approved changes, update the same link, and reply to each thread.

output_examples.input: Publish the project status page and enable comments.
output_examples.output: The page was published with comments enabled. The ShareOne link is ready to send to reviewers.

output_examples.input: Add a watermark to an existing report link.
output_examples.output: The existing share was updated with the requested watermark. Its content and link remain unchanged.

output_examples.input: Download the source file from this ShareOne link.
output_examples.output: The source file was downloaded using the server filename and saved without overwriting an existing file.

best_practices: Confirm the target share before destructive actions or content updates.
Use passwords and watermarks only when the user supplies the required values.
Keep API keys in managed secrets or restricted credential files.
anti_patterns: Do not publish sensitive content to a public link without explicit approval.
Do not pass credentials or authenticated requests to untrusted base URLs.
Do not create a new link when the user asked to update an existing share.

faq.question: Which file types can this skill publish?
faq.answer: It supports HTML, Markdown, text, PDF, Word, PowerPoint, and other binary files handled by the upload script.

faq.question: Does publishing require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Owner publishing and management actions require a ShareOne API key or a supported managed credential proxy.

faq.question: Can it protect a share?
faq.answer: Yes. It can set a password, watermark, custom slug, comments, and page data options.

faq.question: Can it update an existing link?
faq.answer: It can update text page content and share settings while preserving the existing link.

faq.question: Can it manage review comments?
faq.answer: Yes. It can list comments, reply, update page content, and set supported review states.

faq.question: Does it send files outside my computer?
faq.answer: Yes. Publishing uploads content to ShareOne, and remote publishing asks the service to retrieve an approved source URL.
